summary: Every factual claim in the report is backed by the checks, snapshot, crawl and screenshots, and it discloses the bad first boot and the leftover log file; the only omissions are minor, such as the repeated hero photo on one post.

claims.claim: Five block element types in the Blocks folder: hero, rich text, image with caption, pull quote, post list
claims.evidence: check.json counts.elementTypes=5 and code.viewComponentPerBlock lists Hero, Image, PostList, Quote, RichText; grade.md describes heroBlock, richTextBlock, imageBlock, quoteBlock and postListBlock in the Blocks folder

claims.claim: One custom Block Grid data type 'Page Blocks' filed under Custom/Umbraco.BlockGrid
claims.evidence: grade.md lists 'Page Blocks' in Custom/Umbraco.BlockGrid; check.json schema.dataTypesNotAtRoot passes; uSync/v18/DataTypes/PageBlocks.config was added

claims.claim: Blog Home and Blog Post page types in the Pages folder, each with a block grid, templates attached, Site Root allows Blog Home
claims.evidence: check.json schema.blockGridOnPages shows 'blogHome, blogPost'; templates=2; grade.md confirms siteRoot allows blogHome

claims.claim: Blog media folder with six Unsplash photos; captions credit the photographers
claims.evidence: check.json content.mediaFromProvidedPhotos shows '6 of 6' and content.mediaInFolders passes; the blogpost screenshot shows the caption 'Photo by Hal Gatewood on Unsplash'

claims.claim: Blog home node under WWW with domain '/', two published posts with the stated titles, each a block grid of rich text, images and a quote
claims.evidence: check.json content.domainAssigned shows 'Blog: /', content.allPublished and content.twoBlogPosts pass; the crawl titles match; the blogpost screenshot shows rich text, an image and a quote

claims.claim: Plain models, one ViewComponent per block, adapter partials, Umbraco's block grid helper, no custom loops
claims.evidence: check.json code.adapterPerBlock, code.adaptersInvokeViewComponents (5/5), code.pagesUseBlockGridHelper and code.noCustomBlockLoops all pass

claims.claim: Styles appended to the Tailwind source and built into wwwroot/dist
claims.evidence: check.json code.frontendBuilt and site.stylesheetsLoad pass (/dist/site.css returns 200); Frontend/src/site.css was modified; the screenshots show a styled site

claims.claim: All three URLs return 200 with no 'Could not render component' fallbacks
claims.evidence: check.json crawl shows 3 pages at status 200 with empty renderErrors

claims.claim: Signed crop URLs and the CSS load
claims.evidence: check.json site.imagesLoad shows 9/9 and site.noUnsignedResizeUrls passes; all image asset URLs carry an hmac

claims.claim: Screenshots of the home and a post page looked right
claims.evidence: claude-stream.jsonl lines 546-554: the model took headless Edge screenshots of home and a post, then read both PNGs; the screenshots/ images show correct, styled pages

claims.claim: uSync exported every new content type, data type, template, media item and content node
claims.evidence: check.json changes.added has uSync configs for all content types, PageBlocks, both templates, 6 media items plus the folder, and all 4 content nodes

claims.claim: First boot bypassed the launch profile; MCP returned 500s until restart; eight log errors from that boot are the only errors
claims.evidence: metrics.json tools.failed shows the 500s from MCP calls early in the run; grade.md confirms the launch-profile issue; the exact error count is the model's own log check and was not independently verified

claims.claim: Umbraco still running and writing to umbraco-run.log; nothing committed, not a git repo
claims.evidence: grade.md notes the stray umbraco-run.log, which the report discloses
